Done. The fix is a one-line addition in `src/diff/children.js:57-63`: bigint children now get normalized into text vnodes (like strings and numbers) instead of falling through to the vnode-reuse branch, which crashed with `TypeError: can't assign to property ... on 5n: not an object` when `_parent`/`_depth` were set on the primitive.

Verification:
- Browser suite (`test/browser`): 944 tests pass, including `should render bigint as text content` — the only failure is a pre-existing focus-event capture test that fails identically on pristine source (headless Chrome quirk)
- Node/shared tests: 29 passing
- Lint passes (`valid-typeof` in ESLint 5 doesn't know `bigint`, hence the inline disable)
- Also validated re-render paths: bigint → bigint, bigint → number, bigint inside elements all render correctly (bigints are stringified via `document.createTextNode`, so `5n` renders as `5`)
